official.gmail-manager.blurb: Lets agents read, search, and triage your Gmail. Google sign-in and tokens stay on your machine — mChatAI+ never holds them.

official.image-processor.blurb: Resize, convert, and thumbnail images for pipelines and agents — all processing happens locally.

official.pdf-reader.blurb: Extracts text, metadata, and single pages from PDFs so agents can read documents on your machine.

official.ocr-reader.blurb: Pulls text out of images and scans with Tesseract OCR, entirely on your machine.

official.icon-maker.blurb: Composes app icons — PNG, .icns, and full AppIcon sets — from icon glyphs, gradients, textures, and text. The publish flow's Make Icon uses it.
